segments.note: air: the market street reads in a second; out at 1.25 so the fireball is on screen before the third second; picture 07b3: a still wide of the street with walkers, read at 1.1 s, kept short on purpose for the three-second fireball
Meera looks up, the fireball, the glass, her mother's wave with closed lips, her own wave, the dust wall, her face in the dust: all whole

join: c2 opens behind Meera on the thinning dust, a new angle and not c1's dust wall again, both kept; her call, the listening beat and her second call whole; air: she stands still by the shopfront after 8.25
the close on her eyes ends her search

join: a new beat in the same street, the villagers look up; the blazing object, the old shopkeeper, the torn fields, the ducking villagers and the crushed shops alternate as asked, all whole; air: the plume over the distant shops has read by 11.0
air: the young man's stare at the horizon has read by 13.2
the landing is felt: the villagers stagger and the street shakes, held to the end of the rumble
join: a scene change from the shaking street to the farm road; the road's first second is still, so the pickup's approach is kept to 1.6 s
the cab, the streak, the brake, the ditch, the jolt, Suman slumped: short shots, all whole

join: c5 opened on c4's last frame again, starts after the repeat at 0.167; the truck in the ditch from outside is a new angle with the dust settled, kept; Suman's line whole; air: the boy's look up has read by 14.25; join: the 0.21 s sliver of Devendra climbing out at 14.54 is cut on its shot change
air: Devendra's look up past the boy has read by 2.1
the torn field, then the slow tilt up the towering craft held whole as asked, Devendra, the low hatch, Suman's look
join: c7 opened on c6's last frame again, starts after the repeat at 0.167; the three small under the craft is a new wide, kept to 1.5 s as nothing moves after it

join: Devendra's close is the shot of his line, not c6's look again; Suman, the boy's two hands, her look down, then the boy from the chest up held whole: his eyes turn blue and one pulse of light shows at his collar, the episode ends on him
